description: Trait de côte du versant littoral du pays d'Auge ( communes de Villerville et Cricqueboeuf) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by letg.univ-nantes.fr. Coastal feature of the base of the slope determined by analysis of a topographic plan from 1976 to the scale 1/2 000th. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Coastal feature of the coastal slope of the Pays d'Auge (communes of Villerville and Cricqueboeuf)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include levé, trait de côte. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
